title: Poor upgrades to app
body: I used to use it and recommend it to my patients with memory issues, but lately I hate it.   It’s too cumbersome and it drives me crazy that if I just enter a task without a specific time it reminds me immediately after entering the task.   If I just entered it, I don’t need to be reminded 10 seconds later.

title: Deletes reminders and details
body: Works great until you try to use it on both desktop and mobile app— it doesn’t properly sync so you’ll lose reminders. Also, sometimes I’ll set a reminder for a future time/date and a few minutes later, it’ll revert to the current/day/time. The bug that really pushed me to write this review though was that, likely due to some update, ALL of my subtasks for ALL of my reminders that has subtasks are GONE. Absolutely tons of routines and data are completely gone now. Horrible and disappointing.
developer_response: We're very sorry to hear about your experience. This definitely isn't expected behavior, and your reminders and subtasks should not disappear. Please contact our support team at https://www.any.do/contact_form and, if possible, include a screen recording along with your device details so we can investigate and help restore your data.

title: Good but not AI powered as advertised
body:
This is a pretty good app for keeping yourself organized and working together as a group

However, it’s not as integrated into the Apple ecosystem as I would like, nor does it have the AI capabilities that it’s advertised - or at least I haven’t really discovered any

It needs to have a function that allows you to clear all of your done tasks without having to click the X on each single one of them that’s a little bit annoying
developer_response: Thank you for your thoughtful feedback! We'd like to clarify that Any.do already includes several AI-powered features, including AI Suggestions for Workspace boards, lists, tasks, and subtasks, AI Voice Mode, ChatGPT Integration and our MCP server, which connects with Agents such as ChatGPT and Claude 🤓 You also mentioned clearing completed tasks - on the mobile app, this can be done quickly with a simple shake gesture. It sounds like some of these features may have been easy to miss. We encourage you to explore the Help Center(https://support.any.do/) available in the app's Settings or contact our support team at https://www.any.do/contact_form. We'd be happy to help you get the most out of Any.do.

title: Keeps notifying me—of nothing!
body: This app is a joke. It pops up a notice, I open the app, and—voila! Nothing to see here, folks. All I want is a reminder of a task that’s due because i-Calendar stopped doing anything but giving a tiny beep at 9am. In the last two years I’ve missed several important dates. If I’m not in the room, too bad. With Any.do, I might as well just make myself check my calendar every day in spite of there being possibly 20 events at most I need to attend to on time annually. I want a refund!
developer_response: We're sorry to hear about your experience. Notifications should always take you to the relevant task. Please contact our support team at https://www.any.do/contact_form and include more details about your settings and some screenshots so we can investigate what's happening on your device.

title: Decent
body:
It’s a decent app. But the visual craft and layout of everything just feels ancient, like it hasn’t been looked at by a designer in 10 years. 

The developer response is telling: defensive and clueless. If they cared about minimalism, they wouldn’t have ugly gradients from 2006, poor item spacing across the entire app, poorly chosen and inconsistent icons, and ugly backgrounds with no option of customizing them. If they knew anything about real design, they wouldn’t say “design is subjective”. It looks like it was designed by a second semester design intern. 

I don’t have the energy to do a full design crit of the app in an app store review. But this silly developer response was enough for me to stop using the app. They clearly are just coasting at this point and have no desire to make the app better anymore.
developer_response: Thank you for sharing your perspective. Any.do’s design philosophy has always centered around simplicity, clarity, and minimal distraction. Many of our users specifically choose Any.do because of its clean interface and focused approach to productivity. Design preferences are naturally subjective, and we understand that our approach will not appeal to everyone. Rather than following visual trends or adding unnecessary complexity, we continue to prioritize a simple, organized, and efficient experience. We respect your opinion, even if we disagree with your assessment, and we wish you the very best in finding the productivity solution that best fits your preferences!

title: ALMOST Perfect
body: On the website, you’re able to change the background, but on the app you cannot. Wish you could change the background on the app too! Otherwise, this is a great app for students and office workers who just need an app that they can jot down notes and to-do’s! I personally enjoy using the desktop website more than the iOS app (at least on iPad), as it is more streamlined and easier to see, plus it’s more aesthetically pleasing on the website due to the aforementioned background problem. Finally, I wish there was an optional “widget” within the app that functioned like a sticky note on the wall. I.e jot down a reminder that you want to keep on the screen at all times; I do want to reiterate that this feature should be removable and optional to have, as not everyone would want it. However, the app is good as is, and I will be using this for my senior year!
developer_response: Thank you for the thoughtful feedback! 😊 We’re glad Any.do has been helpful for your studies and daily organization. We appreciate the suggestions about app backgrounds and sticky-note style widgets, and we’ll share them with the team. Wishing you an amazing senior year! 🙌

title: Calendar View has issues
body: When I’m in calendar view and want to look at the standard calendar that is displayed at the top of the page, it only shows the month that I am on in the list below. If I want to change the month, I can’t simply swipe to the left to go ahead 1 month or to the right to go back 1 month as it may take me to a totally different month (like if I am in January and swipe to the left to go up one month, it may take me to June or July instead, if it moves at all). So to get the calendar at the top to change to the correct month I want to view, I have to scroll in the list below to the specific month and then scroll in the calendar until it correctly corresponds with the month I want to view. This is such an annoying issue that needs to be fixed. I’ve been looking for an app similar to Sorted 3 ever since they seemed to have stopped working on it as I don’t need any fancy todo/calendar/reminder/planning/gtd app that does anything and everything, just a simple app as Sorted 3 was, which Any.do is.
developer_response: Thanks for sharing this! That does sound unusual 🤔 We’d love to look into it—could you send a quick screen recording to our team at https://www.any.do/contact_form? That’ll help us pinpoint and fix the issue ASAP!

title: The app that could be the one
body: In The Matrix, before Neo learns he is the one, is he the one? Either way, he has the potential… but he isn’t ready. Any.do feels like that. On paper, the feature set and UI/UX seem amazing. But the reality is it isn’t ready to take on the world. I’m sure it is great for some things, but for me the bugs and odd limitations really keep it from being anything more than a could have been. I think if they focused on really cleaning up their features and not adding more additional features or payment tiers, they could find their way to something worthy of being the one. Instead it’s a great idea… in theory.
developer_response:
Thank you for sharing your perspective! 😊 We’re always working to refine Any.do and deliver the best experience possible. That said, to truly understand and address your concerns, we’d need more specific details about the bugs or limitations you encountered.

General observations are a great starting point, but actionable feedback allows our team to investigate and improve in meaningful ways. If you’re open to it, we’d love for you to contact our support team directly at https://www.any.do/contact_form 🤓 Sharing those details would help us work toward making Any.do “the one” for you and others!

title: 1.  Requires an account. Cannot test otherwise.  2. Privacy concerns.
body: Users are forced to set up an account even to explore the app. That’s a major concern and an invasive requirement. I do not want my personal, private information synced to a 3rd party server. Developers: Let us explore your app WITHOUT having to set up an account. Give us an option later of synching, locally or via iCloud if we chose to—and even to skip your servers! Respect our privacy — and let us try your app without an account; that is, to test the waters first! THANKS FOR YOUR RESPONSE, BUT YOU MISS THE KEY POINT! 1. Give us the ability to TEST your app without having to FIRST set up an account. We need to know if it's even a viable todo app before synching our data. 2. As to the privacy concerns, give users the OPTION to sync directly to their Mac if they would like to. Don't force 3rd party server syncing upon users! Better apps respect users' privacy concerns and give them options!
developer_response: Thanks for the feedback! We ask users to create an account in order to save their data and sync it across all platforms so their items are always available, anytime any place. This ensures no information is ever lost and that you're able to utilize the app on all supported devices 🤓 As this is an inherent functionality in order to test the app, you will need to create an account. We're afraid that we cannot remove parts of the app just for testing. That said, we of course respect your preference and hope you will find the best solution for your needs!

title: I was THRILLED…UNTIL
body:
I was looking for any.do to be a replacement for Meister Task which I LOVE. I was so thrilled to find out all of the integrations that were available for this app, including ChatGPT.

… And then I realized that you can ONLY access the Kanban style views if you pay extra for teams or a family plan, which I do not need. Because visual planning and since Kanban is the project management system and style I have used for decades, this isn’t a nice to have, it’s a MUST have. 

AND…. That the Kanban functionality, even if I DO upgrade, is only available via the Webb… And not the Mac, iPhone or iPad apps.😢

This app has some amazing functionality and beautiful design… but without universal access to Kennan boards…It’s a fail for me. I’m sure other people love it, but I can’t believe that this isn’t standard across all tiers -  just like almost every other productivity app out there, including Trello, which is just as affordable.
developer_response: Thanks for the feedback! The personal plans were always designated for personal use based on lists and todos 🤓 The boards are indeed designed for project management (as  stated by you), which is why they are part of our more advanced plans. Many of our personal users actually prefer the simplicity of lists only and therefore that's the focus of the personal space. That said, we have many single members using the Workspace/Family plans in order to work with the boards and the price point for a single member is the same as the personal plan - giving users full flexibility in choosing their preference 😊 As to the boards - they are fully supported on mobile devices and you can easily work with them through your iPhone/iPad! As to the Mac app, it includes the exact same features as the web app so we're not entirely sure why you believe otherwise 🧐 That said, we have made sure to pass your feedback on to our Produce Team for further review and hope to see you back in the future as our product evolves!

Deleting the app is not the same as cancelling the plan and if you have not done so payments will continue to occur. If you did not reach out to our team (via the chat support available in the app, our site and our Help Center) during the refund period then our team would not be able to offer a refund. We recommend cancelling the plan per the details on our Help Center to avoid any further charges.
